summary.text: John Jordan is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 42, appointed in January 2026, and is seeking election against Democrat Courtney Vandall in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Jordan was appointed to the House of Delegates by Governor Patrick Morrisey on January 13, 2026, to replace Brandon Steele.
Jordan advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
